protocol_name: Single-cell processing inside semi-permeable capsules: Emulsion break, curing, wash and capsule filter chip

events.narration: IR step 12 (capsule_trap): load the droplets from the hand-off from chip1_encapsulation: syringe on inlet_1 at 5 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 12 (capsule_trap): exchange to emulsion_breaking_agent: FEED emulsion_breaking_agent_in (emulsion_breaking_agent) at 5 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash (default flow). Add emulsion-breaking agent and remove the oil phase.

IR step 13 (capsule_trap): exchange to photoinitiator: FEED inlet_1 (photoinitiator) at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (75 uL) per wash (default flow). Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.
IR step 13 (capsule_trap): cure under 405 nm light for 30 s, all ports capped. Photocure the capsule shells with 405 nm light in the presence of photoinitiator.

IR step 14 (capsule_trap): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED inlet_1 (wash_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT trap_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash x 3 washes (default flow). Wash the capsules in buffer to remove oil and free reagents.
IR step 15 (aggregate_filter): transfer: FEED inlet_1 (carrier_buffer) at 20 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped. Filter the capsules through a strainer to remove aggregates.
